newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market volume up 9 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market volume up 9 pct in Sept.

text.p: Volume on China's interbank renminbi exchange continued to rise in September, with average daily turnover up 9.7 percent over August, the Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.
Total volume on the exchange, set up in January this year, was 56.8383 billion yuan, compared with 54.278 billion in August, the newspaper said.
The seven-day contract accounted for 35.41 percent of turnover.
Interbank rates fell during the month due to adequate supplies of capital, the newspaper said.
